zh.sourceText: 某科技公司宣布将全面取消远程办公，回归线下办公。管理层解释：远程办公降低了团队协作效率，因为面对面沟通比视频会议高效得多；而且，长期远程会让员工缺乏归属感，优秀人才更容易流失。支持这一决定的数据显示，过去一年远程办公的项目平均延期 30%。不过也有员工表示，每天通勤三小时才是真正的效率杀手。某办公软件厂商趁机推销：『重回办公室，效率立刻翻倍！』

textRefs.conclusion_1: 全面取消远程办公，回归线下办公
textRefs.reason_1: 远程办公降低了团队协作效率
textRefs.reason_2: 长期远程会让员工缺乏归属感，优秀人才更容易流失
textRefs.distractor_1: 重回办公室，效率立刻翻倍
textRefs.distractor_2: 每天通勤三小时才是真正的效率杀手

hints: 结论在开头：管理层决定怎么做？
两个理由分别关于『协作效率』和『员工留任』
『延期 30%』只是数字，注意它属于哪一方；通勤和广告都不支持结论
zh.explanation: 结论是「全面取消远程办公」。理由一：远程降低协作效率；理由二：远程削弱归属感、人才易流失。『延期 30%』是支撑理由的补充数据。而「通勤三小时是效率杀手」是员工的反对观点，「效率立刻翻倍」是软件厂商的营销口号——它们都不是支持取消远程的理由。一个论证里常混着多方的声音，要逐一归位。

en.sourceText: A tech company announced it will fully abolish remote work and return to the office. Management explains: remote work lowers team collaboration efficiency, because face-to-face communication is far more effective than video meetings. Moreover, long-term remote work makes employees feel less connected, and top talent is more likely to leave. Data supporting this decision shows that remote projects were delayed by 30% on average last year. Some employees, however, say that a three-hour daily commute is the real efficiency killer. An office-software vendor is cashing in: 'Back to the office, double your efficiency instantly!'

textRefs.conclusion_1: fully abolish remote work and return to the office
textRefs.reason_1: remote work lowers team collaboration efficiency
textRefs.reason_2: long-term remote work makes employees feel less connected
textRefs.distractor_1: Back to the office, double your efficiency instantly
textRefs.distractor_2: a three-hour daily commute is the real efficiency killer

hints: The conclusion is at the start: what decision did management make?
'30% delayed' is a number — note whose side it supports; the commute and the ad don't
en.explanation: The conclusion is 'fully abolish remote work'. Reason one: remote lowers collaboration efficiency. Reason two: remote weakens belonging and loses talent. 'Delayed by 30%' backs up the reasons. 'Commute is the efficiency killer' is the employees' objection, and 'double your efficiency' is vendor marketing — neither supports the decision. Arguments often mix many voices; sort each one to its owner.
